story:
Why this one matters: Round 1 of the 2026 WNBA Playoffs delivered immediate drama on Sunday as Caitlin Clark and the Indiana Fever stole home-court advantage with an 86-80 victory over the Atlanta Dream at Gateway Center Arena.

Clark tallied 24 points and 11 assists, hitting two crucial step-back three-pointers in the final two minutes to hold off an Atlanta comeback. In Minneapolis, the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx suffocated the Washington Mystics in an 84-69 rout led by Napheesa Collier's 26 points.

At Chase Center, Breanna Stewart and the New York Liberty fended off the Golden State Valkyries 79-71, while the defending champion Las Vegas Aces defeated the Dallas Wings 92-81 behind A'ja Wilson's 28 points. With the opening round contested as best-of-three, all four trailing teams now face must-win Game 2 scenarios.
stakes: Indiana, Minnesota, New York, and Las Vegas take 1-0 series leads in the best-of-three opening round.
rivalryAngle: Playoff intensity peaks as road underdogs and top seeds battle for second-round berths.
